Sāyaṇa also offers an alternative (yadvā: the fire kindled by the hymn's seer Śraddhā) and takes the Śraddhā of the second line as the presiding deity; the sentence gives his first gloss only and denies neither. The Nirukta also treats the verse (9.31) but is not named, so nothing is misattributed.
